check_ins.text: Morning update, SHORT. Format: one line greeting with the date and an emoji. Then groups, each with an emoji heading and ONE BLANK LINE between groups: 📅 Today (events, or 'Nothing on'); 🗓️ Coming up (next 2 events only); ⏰ Reminders today (each as a short phrase with time and its own emoji, no sentences, merge food nudges into one line). Every line is a short phrase of 6 words or fewer, never a full sentence. No explaining, no recap of yesterday beyond one phrase. End with one short line: 'Change any? Tap below.' then at most one short question. Whole message about 10 lines.
